subject: Globalize renewal & expanded UI localization scope
messages:
From: Lucy Chen <lucy@globalize.co>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-contracts@globalize.co
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Globalize renewal & expanded UI localization scope

Hi Monica / Dev,

Thanks again for partnering with Globalize this year — we've enjoyed working with your docs and i18n teams on the Redwood product content and onboarding flows. Attached is a revised renewal proposal (v3) that reflects the 12-month renewal plus the expanded UI localization scope (additional languages: JA, KO) and a modest uplift for dedicated engineering support during the rollout window.

High level: 
- Current baseline renewal: $85k/year for docs + QA.
- Expanded UI localization (JA, KO) + engineering support: +$42k one-time scope uplift; or we can amortize into a $118k annual plan.
- Volume discounts available if you commit to 18 months.

Attachments: Globalize_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf, Globalize_Pricing_Sheet_Q4.xlsx

Next steps we recommend: a quick sync with procurement/legal to confirm SLA and data handling (we support enterprise KMS flows) and a scoped SOW for the UI strings and integration checklist. Happy to join a call early next week.

Thanks,
Lucy Chen
Head of Customer Success | Globalize
[lucy@globalize.co]

[Attachment: Globalize_Renewal_Proposal_v3.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Globalize_Pricing_Sheet_Q4.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Chen <lucy@globalize.co>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Globalize renewal & expanded UI localization scope

Hi Lucy — thanks for the proposal and the clear options. Quick notes from our side: 

- We need the SOW to call out data handling (no persistent storage of PII, logs retention 90 days) and an explicit rollback SLA for production UI strings.
- Procurement will require the vendor questionnaire and SOC2 evidence; can you confirm the latest SOC2 report is available and who to send the security questionnaire to (vendor-contracts@globalize.co is fine).
- On pricing: the team prefers annual budgeting. Can you provide a comparison of the one-time uplift vs amortized annual cost (total TCO over 12/18 months)? The pricing sheet helps but a plain line-item total will make approvals smoother.

Also cc'ing Grace to align on procurement timeline — Grace, can you advise on our approval window? We are hoping to complete vendor selection by Nov 10 to align with product release in late Jan.

Lucy — can you send a redlined SOW and an editable DocuSign package so legal can start reviewing?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Head of Localization Programs | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Globalize — Redline SOW and updated pricing (v3.1)

Forwarding the vendor's files — please review and confirm next actions. My take:

1) Ask for the 200-string sample for JA (Japanese) only — we don't need KO immediately and shipping scope could be phased. Sample will help product QA assess contextual accuracy.
2) Negotiate to cap the one-time uplift at $30k if we commit to 18 months (they've asked for $42k). That keeps total ARR within our budget band.
3) Legal: run a quick pass on the rollback SLA language and confirm indemnity limits.
4) Procurement: if SOC2 link is valid and redline SOW is acceptable, we can request DocuSign and aim to have countersigned doc by Nov 14 to meet your Nov 10 internal deadline (Grace — can you confirm if Nov 14 works for procurement/finance?).

Grace — please ping Procurement and Legal and let me know if you'd like me to loop in Jonas Weber for final approval. Dev — can you confirm the integration checklist below is feasible in the Jan release window?

Thanks,
Monica
